## 🎨 Design

- **Follows GlimStone 4.5.4.** Buttons, rows, menus and tiles light up in one hover color made from your accent, and the text on them stays readable for every accent you pick.
- **Accent text reads well on every surface.** In the light theme the accent's text color sits a little deeper and keeps a contrast of at least 4.5:1 on cards as well as on white.
- **A clearer focus ring.** The ring around whatever the keyboard is on is drawn solid in the accent's text color, on the accent swatches and the drop area too, and grows thicker when your system asks for more contrast.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Help goes to GitHub and Discord.** The Help card in the Info tab names both, and a Discord button takes the mail button's place. It opens CastleParcel's Discord server.
- **The GlimStone version in the Info tab** opens GlimStone's newest release notes.

## 🌐 Translations

- **One help sentence in all 42 languages**, worded the same as in every other app of the family, and French readers are addressed with tu.
